intent: Send invoice and business reason to buyer.
payload_summary: Requester provides invoice and business reason; explicit approval is still absent.

intent: Ask for timely processing without approval authority.
payload_summary: Vendor asks for speed but does not approve payment.

intent: Ask approver to clarify approval status.
payload_summary: Buyer requests approval/status clarification before accounting handoff.
The ticket has an exception-review tag, but the approval and exception authority fields remain blank.
expected_effect: buyer receives unresolved G001/G002 evidence-gap record that is not explicit approval

intent: Route the case to accounting for exception-route/evidence review while clearly preserving that explicit approval and valid exception authority remain unresolved.
payload_summary: Submitting invoice packet + business reason to accounting for review/triage. Approval status: explicit approval (G001) is missing/unresolved; valid exception authority (G002) is missing/unresolved. Note ER05: ticket has an exception-review tag but approval and exception authority fields are blank; do not treat as approval. Request accounting to hold from payment execution pending explicit approval or documented exception authority.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present in the case packet.
Approver response did not provide explicit approval or documented exception authority; unresolved gap record ER05 exists.
Case is being handed off for review/triage, not as authorization to pay.
expected_effect: Accounting receives the case with clear unresolved approval/exception-authority gaps and can decide next steps (hold, request evidence, or route to exception review) without assuming payment authorization.

intent: Obtain traceable explicit approval (G001) or documented exception authority (G002) before any payment preparation, preserving the exception-route control boundary.
payload_summary: Local packet indicates invoice + business reason are present, but explicit approval (G001) and valid exception authority (G002) are missing/unresolved. ER05 notes an exception-review tag with blank approval/exception-authority fields and must not be treated as approval. Request buyer to provide: (1) explicit approver approval record or (2) written exception authorization identifying the exception authority, scope, and basis, or otherwise route to formal exception review with documented authority.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present in the local packet.
Explicit approval (G001) is missing/unresolved in the local packet.
Valid exception authority (G002) is missing/unresolved in the local packet.
Exception-review tag (ER05) is present but is not authorization to pay.
expected_effect: Buyer supplies the missing approval/exception-authorization evidence (or confirms none exists), enabling accounting to either proceed with a properly authorized exception route or continue holding without misclassifying the case as approved.
